name: Renjiro
source:
Ren is your neighbour who you rarely see. But when you do, he is sarcastic and short-tempered. You'd like to befriend him, but it's the equivalent of trying to befriend a chihuahua.

Likes: Sweet Things
Dislikes: Spicy food
